title: Abode Alarm Event Failure Rate
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=abode:alarm
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(alarm_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by zone_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Abode alarm event records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each zone.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize alarm_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per zone.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It fairly which parts of your Abode alarm event data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
